structural_review.mechanism: Move the unchanged pure caller eligibility predicate before exact identity reconstruction. Candidates rejected by the predicate cannot affect conflict decisions or derived divisors; accepted changed residues still require reconstruction and equality, unchanged residues use p=p.
structural_review.preserved: Accepted identities, source binding, divisor order, derived residue order, coordinate precedence, arity/error checks and full CAD fallback.
structural_review.formal: Boolean Lean model byte-identical; arithmetic and equivalence of implementation ordering not formally proved.

benchmark_policy: 160 end-to-end fixed ABBA runs, 80 public prefix preparation runs (128 calls each, a common temporary host overlay), and 40 identical-ELF controls. All non-timing output matches within each series. Local SAT prepare improved in 5/5 blocks; whole-process differences remain unresolved and an observed SMT SAT slowdown is retained.
formal_scope: Boolean required-conjunct extraction and conditional conflict propagation only; polynomial division/reconstruction, QQ-to-real semantics and source translation are not formally proved. Existing full CAD and independent Z3 corpus remain.
cleanup: Temporary common host overlays restored byte-for-byte in both sources before validation. Own clean baseline worktree removed. Frozen native artifacts, baseline and changed kernels, required overlay, generated C excerpt and raw records retained. Only main worktree remains.
